texte: Great start! Only {{REMAINING}} pixels left to check.
Nice pace. Get comfortable, take a breath.
Solid consistency. Keep that momentum going.
Statistically, every click gets you closer... in theory.
A quarter thousand down. Patience is a virtue.
What's wrong? Keep going, don't quit now. Accomplish at least one thing this week.
1,000 misses... Don't give up, prove you can actually finish something for once.
Don't back down now. The pixel might literally be under your next click.
2,500 clicks. If you leave now, all this effort was for absolute nothing.
5,000 clicks... This isn't just a game anymore, it's a matter of personal pride.
10,000 clicks. Are you really going to let a 1px square defeat you?
18,000 blank shots. Your stubborn resilience is getting scary.
25,000 clicks. Even a marathon runner would have tapped out.
50,000 clicks. At this point, nobody can judge you. Keep clicking.
100,000 clicks. You have officially entered the hall of fame of nothingness.
250,000 clicks. The pixel bows before your unbreakable willpower.
30 seconds in. Nice little warm-up.
1m30... Take a deep breath, you've got all day.
4 minutes. The pixel isn't moving, it's waiting.
10 minutes of scanning. Still right here.
20 minutes. Sun is setting, clicking goes on.
30 full minutes. Your endurance is genuinely terrifying.
50 clicks. Warm-up officially over.
400 clicks. Your index finger is starting to tell its life story.
3,500 clicks. The pixel is starting to feel a little guilty. A little.
7,500 clicks. Your determination passed the threshold of reasonable a long time ago.
35,000 clicks. Scientists are still studying how you're still standing.
150,000 clicks. This isn't a video game anymore, it's an urban legend.
2 minutes 30. You're really missing that coffee you skipped.
7 minutes. A TV episode would've ended by now.
15 minutes. This isn't a game anymore, it's a spiritual retreat.
